黄峥博士主要从事“One Health”框架下的动物疫病生态学研究，以高致病性禽: Dr. Zheng Huang studies the ecology of animal infectious diseases within a One Health framework, focusing on major zoonoses such as highly pathogenic avian influenza, Lyme disease, and bovine tuberculosis. His research examines transmission patterns, risk factors, and ecological mechanisms at community and landscape scales. By uncovering complex relationships among environments, hosts, and pathogens, he aims to provide a theoretical basis for predicting and controlling these diseases.

殷盛来博士主要从事疾病生态学、动物移动生态学与全球变化生物学研究，重点关注迁徙水: Dr. Shenglai Yin studies disease ecology, animal movement ecology, and global change biology, with a focus on migratory waterbirds, avian influenza, and One Health challenges at wildlife-poultry-human interfaces. He combines agent-based and epidemiological models, network analysis, statistical analysis, and machine learning to investigate how animal movement, landscape and climate change, and host community composition jointly shape wildlife disease risk. His work aims to improve predictions of disease spread, cross-species spillover, and emerging infectious diseases, supporting wildlife conservation and animal health.
现任 Journal of Animal Ecology 副主编、Avian R: He serves as an Associate Editor of Journal of Animal Ecology, an Early-career Editorial Board Member of Avian Research, a committee member of the Asian Flyways Collaborative for Waterbirds, and convener and host of the International Forum on Ecology and Evolution of Avian Influenza.

吴强博士主要从事动物生态与保护及疾病生态学研究。在动物生态与保护方面，以鸟类、两: Dr. Qiang Wu studies animal ecology and conservation, as well as disease ecology. His work on animal ecology and conservation focuses on birds, amphibians, and reptiles, examining patterns of animal diversity, conservation, and responses to environmental changes such as habitat fragmentation and climate change. In disease ecology, he focuses on avian haemosporidian parasites and wildlife pathogens associated with parasitic ticks and mites. He investigates spatial patterns and maintenance mechanisms of pathogen diversity, responses of host-pathogen interaction networks to environmental change, and ecological drivers of disease transmission risk.
